paper: 2025年12月大学英语四级 第3套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on how students can make the best use of on-campus resources for academic development. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: Universities offer students a wealth of resources, yet many students use only a small part of them. In my opinion, making the best use of on-campus resources is one of the keys to academic development.

The library is the most obvious place to start. Apart from borrowing books, students can search its online databases for up-to-date research and attend its training sessions on finding information. Teachers are another valuable resource. Instead of meeting professors only in class, students should visit them during office hours to discuss questions and seek advice on further study. In addition, laboratories, academic lectures and student research groups provide opportunities to apply knowledge and explore new fields.

To make full use of these resources, students need to plan ahead and take the initiative. For example, they can check the lecture schedule every week and set aside regular time for the library. Those who actively explore what their university offers will not only improve their academic performance but also develop the ability to learn independently.

paper: 2025年12月大学英语四级 第2套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: Suppose it is proposed that all university students should be required to learn academic writing. You are now to write a response by stating what you think of the proposal. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: It has been proposed that all university students should be required to learn academic writing. I strongly support this proposal, for academic writing is a basic skill that every student needs, regardless of major.

First of all, academic writing is essential for university study itself. Students must be able to present ideas clearly, organize arguments logically and cite sources properly, whether they are writing a lab report, a course paper or a graduation thesis. Without systematic training, many of them simply copy information from the Internet or make claims without evidence. Moreover, learning to write academically sharpens critical thinking. To produce a convincing paper, one has to evaluate evidence, compare different views and draw sound conclusions, a habit that is valuable in any career.

Of course, to work well, the course should be designed to meet the needs of different majors. Engineering students, for instance, may focus on technical reports and data presentation, while literature students practice writing critical essays. With such flexibility, the requirement will truly benefit every student.

paper: 2025年12月大学英语四级 第1套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: Suppose the student union of your university is collecting opinions on improving its work for the coming year. You are now to write a response by suggesting how it can better enrich student life. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: I am glad that the student union is collecting opinions on its work for the coming year. Over the past year, it has organized many popular events, but there is still room to make student life richer and more meaningful. Here are my suggestions.

First, the union could offer activities that suit a wider range of interests. Besides sports games and singing contests, it might organize book clubs, hiking trips and cooking classes, so that quieter students can also find something they enjoy. Second, it should pay more attention to students’ practical needs, for example by inviting graduates to share their job-hunting experience or arranging short workshops on public speaking. Third, the union could conduct a brief online survey after each event to learn what students liked and what could be improved.

If the student union listens carefully to students and keeps improving its work, campus life will become more varied and rewarding, and every student will feel more connected to the university. I look forward to taking part in its activities next year.

paper: 2025年6月大学英语四级 第3套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: Suppose your university is conducting a survey to collect students’ opinions on the appropriate use of AI technology in assisting learning. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: AI tools such as chatbots and translation apps have quickly become part of students’ daily learning. In my view, AI can be a powerful learning assistant, but only if it is used appropriately.

Used wisely, AI can make learning more efficient. It can explain difficult concepts in simple language, recommend useful materials and point out grammar mistakes in students’ writing. When students get stuck on a problem late at night, AI can offer help immediately. However, AI should support learning rather than replace thinking. If students simply let AI write their essays or do their homework, they will miss the chance to develop their own abilities and may even be guilty of academic dishonesty. Moreover, AI sometimes produces inaccurate information, so its answers should always be checked.

Therefore, students should use AI as a tutor, not as a ghostwriter. For example, they can ask it to explain an idea after first trying to understand it on their own. Universities should also set clear rules on its use, so that AI truly helps students learn better.

paper: 2025年6月大学英语四级 第2套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions on the necessity of making College Chinese a compulsory course. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: Our university is seeking students’ opinions on whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course. In my view, it is necessary to make it compulsory for all students.

To begin with, a good command of the Chinese language is essential for both study and work. Many university students, especially those majoring in science and engineering, have difficulty writing clear reports, emails and applications. College Chinese can help them improve their reading and writing skills, which are needed in every profession. Moreover, the course introduces students to classical poetry, prose and novels, which carry the wisdom and values of Chinese culture. Studying these works not only broadens their horizons but also deepens their understanding of their own cultural heritage.

Some may argue that students are already busy with courses in their majors. However, the course need not be a heavy burden if it is well designed, with practical writing tasks and engaging readings. Therefore, I believe that making College Chinese compulsory would benefit students both now and in the future.

paper: 2025年6月大学英语四级 第1套
limit: at least 120 words but no more than 180 words
prompt: Directions: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on the development of students’ cross-cultural communication abilities. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
body: In an increasingly globalized world, the ability to communicate across cultures has become essential for university students. Whether they study abroad, work for international companies or simply make friends online, students will inevitably deal with people from different cultural backgrounds.

To develop this ability, students should first build a solid foundation in foreign languages, since language is the bridge between cultures. However, language alone is not enough. Students also need to learn about the customs, values and ways of thinking in other countries, which they can do by reading widely, watching foreign films and taking courses in intercultural communication. More importantly, they should seek real opportunities for interaction, such as joining international exchange programs or helping foreign students adapt to campus life.

Throughout this process, students should keep an open mind and respect differences instead of judging others by their own standards. At the same time, they should be confident in introducing Chinese culture to the world. In this way, they can become true bridges between China and other countries.
